headline: 21 deaths recorded as dengue cases surge in Chittagong this year
summary: The port city is facing a significant increase in dengue fever cases, leading to multiple fatalities this year.
details: Chittagong is experiencing a sharp rise in dengue fever cases this year, putting pressure on healthcare facilities.
According to reports, 21 people have already died from the virus in the city.
The surge in cases highlights the ongoing challenge of controlling the mosquito-borne illness in the region.
Health authorities are urged to take more stringent measures to prevent further spread and reduce the death toll.

headline: Olise brace as France thrash Belgium 4-1 in Nations League comeback
summary: Michael Olise scored twice off the bench to lead France to a dominant victory at the Stade de France, securing Zinedine Zidane's first home win as manager.
details: France overcame an early deficit to defeat Belgium 4-1 in their Nations League Group A1 clash on Monday. The victory was secured through a late surge of goals in the final 15 minutes of the match.

Belgium took an early lead in the 35th minute through Dodi Lukebakio. France struggled to break through Belgium's defensive block for much of the game, marking their eighth consecutive match without a first-half goal.
The momentum shifted when Zinedine Zidane introduced substitutes Michael Olise and Rayan Cherki. Desire Doue leveled the score in the 77th minute with a strike from the edge of the box.
Michael Olise then took over, providing an assist for Cherki to put France ahead before scoring two goals of his own in quick succession during and just before stoppage time.
Zinedine Zidane praised the 'extraordinary second half' and the team's ability to turn the match around. Olise described the win as a 'team effort' following Zidane's tactical ideas.
In another Group A1 match, Italy secured a 3-1 win over Turkey. Goals from Gianluca Scamacca, Riccardo Calafiori, and Pio Esposito ensured Italy's third consecutive match without a loss.
France now sits at the top of the group with 10 points, leading Italy by three and Belgium by four. Turkey remains at the bottom with four losses from four matches.
caption:
From 1-0 down to a 4-1 demolition! Michael Olise's late masterclass fires France to a stunning comeback win.

France overcame an early deficit to defeat Belgium 4-1 in their Nations League Group A1 clash on Monday. The victory was secured through a late surge of goals in the final 15 minutes of the match.

Belgium took an early lead in the 35th minute through Dodi Lukebakio. France struggled to break through Belgium's defensive block for much of the game, marking their eighth consecutive match without a first-half goal.

The momentum shifted when Zinedine Zidane introduced substitutes Michael Olise and Rayan Cherki. Desire Doue leveled the score in the 77th minute with a strike from the edge of the box.

Michael Olise then took over, providing an assist for Cherki to put France ahead before scoring two goals of his own in quick succession during and just before stoppage time.

Zinedine Zidane praised the 'extraordinary second half' and the team's ability to turn the match around. Olise described the win as a 'team effort' following Zidane's tactical ideas.

In another Group A1 match, Italy secured a 3-1 win over Turkey. Goals from Gianluca Scamacca, Riccardo Calafiori, and Pio Esposito ensured Italy's third consecutive match without a loss.

France now sits at the top of the group with 10 points, leading Italy by three and Belgium by four. Turkey remains at the bottom with four losses from four matches.
